item.text:
Implemented a complete installable `ydata-profiling` project under [pyproject.toml](/workspace/pyproject.toml), with the main API centered in [profile_report.py](/workspace/src/ydata_profiling/profile_report.py), configuration in [config.py](/workspace/src/ydata_profiling/config.py), and a broad compatibility surface across `model`, `report`, `visualisation`, `utils`, CLI, and the pandas extension method. The package supports `ProfileReport`, `compare`, HTML/JSON/widget-style output, type inference, per-column summaries, correlations, missing-data views, duplicates, alerts, sensitive redaction, serialization, expectations export, and the requested `src/ydata_profiling/__init__.py` API entrypoint.

Local verification passed with [tests/test_basic.py](/workspace/tests/test_basic.py): `pytest` reports `6 passed`. I also smoke-tested direct low-level imports like `get_duplicates`, multimethod-style summary functions, the DataFrame decorator, comparison mode, and sensitive-mode redaction. I could not run a real PySpark end-to-end smoke test because the environment lacks a working Java setup (`JAVA_HOME` is not set), and I could not call the `submit` tool because it is not available in this environment.
